# Witness coupon travelling record

## Travelling card
The travelling record, nicknamed the blue card on the kiln floor, carries the run identifier, shelf position, witness-piece serial and observation tick. Attach it to the witness-piece sleeve after cooling. It travels with that sleeve to the inspection bench and then into the run-record envelope after inspection. An unpaired card is marked unmatched rather than attached to the most similar witness piece.

## Coupon identity
The comparison piece has its own serial even if cut from the same clay sheet as production pieces. Its result is an observation about that piece, not an automatic pass for the entire run.
